ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, parallelogram $OABC$ has its side $OA$ on the $x$-axis, and vertex $C$ is on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$. $BC$ intersects the $y$-axis at point $D$, and $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$. If the area of the parallelogram $OABC$ is $8$, what is the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $D$ is the midpoint of $BC$, and the area of parallelogram $OABC$ is 8,\\
it follows that $S_{\triangle OCD}=\frac{1}{4}\times 8=2$,\\
which means $\frac{1}{2}\left|k\right|=2$,\\
thus $k=\pm 4$,\\
since the graph of the inverse proportion function is in the second quadrant,\\
it follows that $k<0$,\\
hence, $k=\boxed{-4}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are coordinate axes, O is at the origin, and OA is the base along the positive direction of the x-axis; quadrilateral OABC is a parallelogram, BC is the upper horizontal side, and intersects the y-axis at D; C is located to the left of the y-axis and above the x-axis, and is on the inverse proportional function curve. Therefore C is in the second quadrant. Then reason: Because D is the midpoint of BC, CD = DB, and BC = 2CD. The height of parallelogram OABC is the distance from O to the horizontal line BC, namely OD, so the area of the parallelogram is BC·OD = 2CD·OD. The area of triangle OCD is (1/2)CD·OD, therefore S_△OCD is 1/4 of the area of the parallelogram. It is known that the area of the parallelogram is 8, so S_△OCD = 8/4 = 2. Let C = (x_C, y_C). Because C is on y = k/x, k = x_C y_C. Also because D is on the y-axis and has the same height as C, the area of triangle OCD is |x_C y_C|/2 = |k|/2. Therefore |k|/2 = 2, giving |k| = 4. In the figure C is in the second quadrant, x_C < 0 and y_C > 0, so k = x_C y_C < 0, hence k = -4.
